question: 列出所有演员的名字，按姓氏升序排序
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM actor ORDER BY last_name ASC;

question: 找出姓氏以 'W' 开头的演员
sql: SELECT * FROM actor WHERE last_name LIKE 'W%';

question: 统计一共有多少部电影
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film;

question: 找出评级为 PG 的所有电影，返回标题和租赁价格
sql: SELECT title, rental_rate FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG';

question: 找出替换成本在 10 到 20 之间的电影
sql: SELECT title, replacement_cost FROM film WHERE replacement_cost BETWEEN 10 AND 20;

question: 找出标题里面包含 'Action' 的电影
sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE title ILIKE '%action%';

question: 查询所有不同的电影评级有哪些
sql: SELECT DISTINCT rating FROM film;

question: 统计客户一共有多少个不同的地区district
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district) FROM address;

question: 列出所有分类名称
sql: SELECT name FROM category;

question: 查询2005年5月1日到2005年6月1日之间的租赁记录
sql: SELECT * FROM rental WHERE rental_date BETWEEN '2005-05-01' AND '2005-06-01';

question: 统计每一种评级的电影数量
sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film GROUP BY rating;

question: 找出时长大于120分钟的电影，按时长从大到小排序
sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length > 120 ORDER BY length DESC;

question: 统计每个演员出演的电影数量，取前10名参演最多的演员
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS movie_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询电影《ACADEMY DINOSAUR》对应的所有演员
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR';

question: 统计每个分类下电影的数量，只保留电影数量大于60的分类
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_cnt FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(fc.film_id) > 60;

question: 查询客户以及他们对应的城市名称
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ci.city FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id;

question: 统计每个员工处理了多少笔支付订单
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS pay_cnt FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

question: 找出总消费超过100元的客户，输出客户id和总金额
sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_pay FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 100;

question: 找出还没有归还的租赁记录，显示客户姓名、电影名称、租赁时间
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, f.title, r.rental_date FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NULL;

question: 查询每部电影的总租金收入，按收入降序
sql: SELECT f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: 查询属于Family、Animation、Documentary分类的电影标题
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name IN ('Family','Animation','Documentary');

question: 找出租赁价格是2.99或者4.99、评级R、标题包含L的前10部电影
sql: SELECT title, rental_rate, rating FROM film WHERE rating='R' AND title LIKE '%L%' AND rental_rate IN (2.99, 4.99) LIMIT 10;

question: 计算每部电影的平均租赁时长
sql: SELECT f.title, AVG(r.return_date - r.rental_date) AS avg_rent_dur FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title;

question: 统计每个分类的租金总收入，只保留总收入大于2000的分类，按收入降序
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 2000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: 查询每个客户平均每笔租赁消费金额
sql: SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id;

question: 找出哪些电影没有任何演员参演
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id WHERE fa.actor_id IS NULL;

question: 找出哪些演员没有出演任何电影
sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE fa.film_id IS NULL;

question: 使用窗口函数，给每个分类内电影按租赁收入排名
sql: WITH film_rev AS (SELECT c.name cat_name, f.title, SUM(p.amount) rev FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id=fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id=f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id=i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id=p.rental_id GROUP BY c.name, f.title) SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cat_name ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rk FROM film_rev;

question: 查询消费总额前三的客户
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) total FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 找出地址里district为空的客户
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id WHERE a.district IS NULL OR a.district = '';

question: 统计每个城市有多少客户
sql: SELECT ci.city, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS cust_cnt FROM city ci JOIN address a ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN customer c ON a.address_id = c.address_id GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC;

question: 查询2005年5月的总营收
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2005-05-01' AND payment_date < '2005-06-01';

question: 找出租金收入高于该分类平均收入的电影
sql: WITH cat_avg AS (SELECT c.name, AVG(rev) avg_rev FROM (SELECT c.name, f.title, SUM(p.amount) rev FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id=fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id=f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id=i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id=p.rental_id GROUP BY c.name, f.title) t GROUP BY c.name), film_rev AS (SELECT c.name cat_name, f.title, SUM(p.amount) rev FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id=fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id=f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id=i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id=p.rental_id GROUP BY c.name, f.title) SELECT fr.* FROM film_rev fr JOIN cat_avg ca ON fr.cat_name=ca.name WHERE fr.rev > ca.avg_rev;

question: 查询每部电影库存有多少份拷贝
sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS stock_count FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title;

question: 找出没有库存的电影
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE i.inventory_id IS NULL;

question: 统计每个员工在2005年6月的收款金额
sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM staff s JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id WHERE p.payment_date BETWEEN '2005-06-01' AND '2005-07-01' GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

question: 查询租赁次数最多的前5部电影
sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) rent_times FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id=i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rent_times DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询哪些客户从来没有租过电影
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c LEFT JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rental_id IS NULL;

question: 统计不同评级电影的平均时长
sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) avg_len FROM film GROUP BY rating;

question: 找出描述里面包含 'Drama' 的电影
sql: SELECT title, description FROM film WHERE description ILIKE '%drama%';

question: 查询国家对应的城市数量
sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(ci.city_id) city_count FROM country co JOIN city ci ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country;

question: 找出所有发生在2006年的支付记录
sql: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2006-01-01';

question: 使用CTE找出消费总额排名前20%的客户
sql: WITH cust_total AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT * FROM cust_total WHERE total >= PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) OVER ();

question: 统计每个月的总租赁收入，按月排序
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS pay_month, SUM(amount) AS month_rev FROM payment GROUP BY pay_month ORDER BY pay_month;

question: 找出同一客户同一天多次租赁的记录
sql: SELECT customer_id, DATE(rental_date), COUNT(*) cnt FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id, DATE(rental_date) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC;

question: 查询每部电影最长和最短租赁间隔
sql: SELECT f.title, MAX(r.return_date - r.rental_date) max_rent, MIN(r.return_date - r.rental_date) min_rent FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id=i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title;
